name: K. Srinivas Rao
bio: Founded PEBSOL in 2009 in Balanagar. Led strategic expansion into Solar MMS in 2014 and the 80,000 sq.ft Medchal plant, scaling company delivery to 1.2M sq.ft PEB and 700 MW solar capacity annually.

name: M. Venkat Reddy
bio: Pioneered PEBSOL's Solar Module Mounting Structures (MMS) portfolio. Has engineered over 2.5 GW of utility-scale ground-mount, tracker, and industrial rooftop solar structures with 180 km/h wind resistance.

name: Archana Nair
bio: Specialist in fast-track Pre-Engineered Building structural design, clear-span hangars, and light-gauge steel framing. Spearheaded the delivery of Azad Engineering's 65,000 sq.ft facility in record 48 days.

name: Rajeshwar Goud
bio: Oversees the state-of-the-art 80,000 sq.ft manufacturing facility in Medchal. Manages automated welding lines, continuous roll-forming purlin lines, and stringent ISO 9001:2015 quality standards.
